english: Hey, Aoi-san?
Huh? Oh, sorry.\nI was concentrating and didn't notice...
The national mock exams are coming up,\nand I've been neglecting my studies lately...
I thought I'd put even free moments like this\nto good use,\nso I was studying.
Studying!?\nYou're studying even now?
Yes - if I let my guard down,\nI get rusty right away.
I think building up a little every day\nis what matters.
How's your mock-exam prep going?
Hmm... even if you say that,\nI don't even know how to study...\nIt's hopeless for me.
It's not hopeless at all.\nIf you'd like, shall we study together?
Could I really place high\non the national mocks?
Well... it depends on your effort.\nNothing starts without trying.
'Genius is 99% effort and 1% inspiration'...\nEdison's famous words.
They say even the most genius people\nall put in effort.
I see...\nMaybe I'll try a little harder.
Ufufu, that's the spirit.
Effort pays off in kind.\nThat's sure to be fun.
Oh, by the way...\nI have some recommended reference books.
If you'd like,\nplease give them a try.
And this one...\noh, and I mustn't forget this one.
Th-this... all of it!?
Yes. Is it... not enough, perhaps?
Then, it's a bit difficult,\nbut how about this workbook?
Ahaha... thanks.
Not at all -\nI've got plenty of reference books.
If there's anything else you'd like to read,\nor any preference, just tell me.
Ahaha... I'll pass...
S-sorry.\nThis one is a bit too hard after all...
I have some easier ones too -\nI'll bring them next time.
I love teaching, actually.\nI still have plenty to work on myself, but...
I always study with Haruka-san,\ntoo.
Can I even do it...?\nI'm not really confident.
Hehe, it's okay.
I'll help you with everything I've got.\nLet's work hard together!
(Man, this is turning into something big...)
Is there anything you don't understand?
Yeah, all of it, honestly...
Huh? All of it...?\nHmm, what should we do...
Then why don't we\nstart over from the basics?
If you nail the basics, you'll be able to\nsolve any problem right away.
Let's learn starting with the easy stuff.\nUm, this is...
(Aoi really is kind...)
...So? Did you understand?
Huh? Y-yeah...
(Crap, I wasn't listening at all...)
Now I'll give you a problem, so\ntry solving it for me.
It's about a famous quote\nfrom a historical figure.
When she said 'if there's no bread,'\nwhat did she say\nto eat instead?
If there's no bread?\nHmm... rice, obviously?
Huh? Hehe, in a way that's correct.\nRight - it means that if there's no bread,\neating something else is fine.
Then I got it right!?
No, unfortunately that's wrong.\nThe correct answer is... cake.
But actually, this quote doesn't\nseem to be Antoinette's at all.
The truth seems to be that it was said by\na noblewoman who didn't even know\nhow expensive cake was...
But since Antoinette had already\nturned the public against her,\nit ended up being attributed to her.
Huh, I see.\nYou don't just teach the material,\nyou teach all kinds of stuff, Aoi.
Hehe, Haruka said\nthe same thing to me.
It sticks in your memory better that way, and\nmore than anything, it's more fun to learn, isn't it?
You're a wonderful tutor!
That's not true at all.\nI just shared how interesting history is,\nexactly as it is.
That's not true.\nI'm sure Haruka appreciates it too.
Hehe, it'd be even better if their grades\nwould go up a little more, though...
You remember better when you're having fun, after all.
You think so too?
Yeah, of course.\nI feel like I could actually get interested in studying.
That makes me happy to hear.\nI'll try even harder too.
Not just history, either.\nMath and science both have ways to learn\nthat stick better than just grinding out answers.
(To have such a kind tutor teaching you\nevery day - Haruka's so lucky...)
Now, once we finish the next page,\nlet's take a break. I've got some\ntasty cake ready...
Cake!?\nY-yeah! I'll do my best!
Hehe...
Ugh, I'm beatt.
Oh my, look at the time.\nI'm sorry, I didn't notice...
Shall we take a break soon?
Really!?
Yes, we've gotten a lot further\nalong than I expected.
You learn fast.\nI feel like you're going to catch up to me in no time.
At this rate, you might even crack\nthe top 10 on the national mock exams.
Don't praise me so much.
Hehe, it's the truth.
Your focus really impressed me.\nThat's not something just anyone can do.
Watching you work so hard makes me\nwant to work harder too...
You're already working plenty hard, Aoi.\nOh, but maybe you should get some exercise once in a while?
Exercise...? Yeah.\nYou're right, I should work on my weaknesses.
I'm good at archery, but\npretty useless at everything else...
Running is my worst. Even in the mornings,\nkeeping up with Haruka is\nall I can manage...
I really should work on getting up\na bit earlier myself.
Hm? You kind of remind me\nof Blue Angel.
Huh? Hehe, you think so?\nLots of people are bad at sports.
Oh, and there's a saying -\nsupposedly there are three people\nin the world just like you.
Maybe Blue Angel\nis bad at studying\nand running too.
A hero of justice studying - that's weird.
You think so?\nMaybe heroes of justice are just\nregular people like us, too.
Balancing school and work must be tough.\nI hope they do their best.
I wonder what kind of studying they do.
Hehe, who knows?\nA hero-of-justice textbook\nwould be funny, though.
Are you curious too?\nAbout what a hero of justice studies...
But before that, we need to work on\nthe studying right in front of us.
Sigh... yeah...
It's okay. You've gotten so much\nbetter than when you started.
Come on, let's get it done quickly.
Y-yes ma'am.
What should I do...
Uh, what happened?
Actually, I lost a book\nI borrowed from Kurumi...
That's bad.\nI'll help you look.
Huh? Ah, thank you.\nBut please don't worry about it...
You've been busy lately, right?\nYou haven't been coming to study much...
I've been wondering, but I didn't want\nto push you too hard...
I can look for it on my own, so\nplease put your own plans first.
(Actually I've just been dreading studying...\nShould I tell her straight?)
A-actually...
There's something important I need to tell you.
W-with such a serious face...\nWhat is it?
Could it be that\nsomething's troubling you...?
It's about studying.
Yes. Oh, could it be about the\nworkbook I gave you the other day?
There were a lot of hard problems in it, so\nit's fine if you didn't get them.\nI'll explain them properly next time.
Oh? Is that... what's over there?
Oh, this book?\nCould this be...?
Yes! Thank you so much.\nI'm sorry to have worried you.
Thanks to you, we found it right away.
No, I didn't really do anything...\nS-so, there's something I wanted to talk about...
Yes! What is it?
Um, well... studying, I'm, like,\nokay now, or, um...
Okay...? Ah! Maybe\nyou've started going to a cram school?
Then I'm relieved. Cram school teachers\nare study experts, so I'm sure\nthey'll be a big help to you.
I was thinking that studying alone\nwith just a reference book might be a bit rough.
N-no, it's not that, um...
If you're that motivated, then\nthere's no more need for me.
Do your best!!
N-no! That's not it...\nI just... can't do it anymore...!
You helped me so much...\nI'm really sorry!!
Huh?
Sigh... I feel like I did something\nbad to Aoi.
Um...
Oh, Aoi!?
Did I startle you?\nI'm sorry.
Actually, there's something I'd like to ask...
This is sudden, but...\nwhat do you think of cosplay?
Huh? Cosplay?
Yes. There's maids, anime characters,\nall kinds, I think...
I was going to ask Haruka, but\nshe seems to be out.
I thought I should hear a man's opinion too,\nso I asked you.
Hmm, I don't dislike it.\nIf anything, I might like it!\nBut why the sudden question?
I first learned about it on a TV news report\nthe other day...
It was an event where cosplayers\nfrom all over gather, and everyone looked like they were having so much fun.
It seems like there are quite a lot of them,\nso I got a little curious.
Still, I wonder how they prepare\nsuch elaborate costumes.
They make them themselves.
Oh, is that right!?
Making such difficult costumes...\neveryone's amazing...
Can't you buy them at specialty shops?
I see, specialty shops...
Costumes that elaborate must cost\na pretty penny, I'm sure.
Cosplaying takes a lot\nof work too.
Still, you sure know a lot\nabout cosplay.
Have you ever been to\nan event or anything?
O-of course not!\nI've never been to one, not once!
Oh, really? You know so much, I was sure\nyou'd been to one.
Also, I really do think\nyou have talent.\nAre you really giving up on studying...?
Huh!? T-that's...
Please think it over.\nWell then, bye...
Aoi...
Maybe it's too early to give up.\nI'll try a little harder...
...Yeah, let's keep at it.\nI don't want to lose to Aoi and the others...
Hm? Is that... speak of the devil, Aoi?\nShould I say hi...
Oh?
Hi. Oh, are you studying?\nSorry to interrupt.
No, not at all... um,\nit's nice weather today!
On a day like this, how about\na walk outside?
Huh!? But it's cloudy outside...
Huh!? I-is that right...\nSorry, that was weird of me.
It'd be nice if the weather were goodd...\nthat must've been wishful thinking!
You won't\ncome out with me...?
I don't have anything to do, so no.
I-is that right...\nBut moving your body a bit might\ndo you some good!
How about inviting a friend and\ngoing out somewhere?\nIt'll definitely be fun!
I'd rather go with you, Aoi.
M-me? But, um...\nI have something to do after this.
It'll take a while, so today is\nkind of... sorry.
Oh, by the way...\nhow's the studying going?
Huh? Oh, yeah, fine...\nWhat were you studying just now, Aoi?
Me? Um...\nthe usual, yes!
Don't mind me...
Hmm, something's off.\nOh, she's holding a reference book I haven't seen before.
Huh? Ah, th-this is...\nN-no...
It's not really something\ninteresting to look at...
I'm really sorry.\nBut this one thing is a little...
That just makes me more curious...
I'm sorry!\nI'll be going now...!
Maybe... she hates\nme now...?
Makes sense... she taught me so seriously,\nand I said I couldn't do it...
Sigh... I'm the worst.
I should properly apologize\nand have her teach me again...
Hello.
Perfect timing...\nThere's something I'd like to talk about...
What's wrong? You're spacing out.\nIs there something on my face?
Oh, no, it's not that...\nIt's just, do you hate me now...?
Huh? Why would I?\nOf course not.
Did I maybe say something\nthat upset you?
No, it's not that -\nyou hid the book I tried to look at the other day, remember?
That was, well... I didn't hide it\nbecause I dislike you...
It's just, at the time I kind of\nwanted to keep it a secret...
I-I'm sorry, it's nothing.\nActually, there's something I've been wondering about too...
I worry I may have been\nforcing you to study...
That's not true.\nI just lacked motivation...
No, I think my teaching was\njust bad.
So I wanted\nyou to have fun...
What's that got to do with hiding the book?
Um, well... I think it's a book\nthat you can enjoy...
I was going to keep it secret, but\nit was totally obvious, wasn't it.
That sounds fun.
I'm sure you'll like it.
The prep was pretty tough...\nAh! Anything more is a secret.
Anyway, I worked hard so you'd\nbe even a little more motivated.
So... would you have some time\nfor me sometime?
O-of course!!
Thank you.
(Wait, is Aoi asking me out on a date!?\nThis is turning out amazing...)
Is something wrong?
No, n-nothing.
Then I'll look forward to it.\nSee you that day.
Seems like I made her worry instead.\nMaybe I did something bad.
Anyway, I can't waitt.
A date... maybe go to the beach...
It's almost time to meet...
Are you there?
Um, this is a little embarrassing...
Embarrassing...?
Please don't be too surprised.
Um, how do I look?\nIs it weird...?
I actually tried making it from a book.
(Wait, is that the book she hid the other day?)
B-but... I think I got the measurements wrong,\nit's a bit tight...
M-my, it's really emphasizing her chest...
Hmm, I wonder if they grew againn?
I was a little adventurous\nto get you motivated, but...
There's still a bit too much exposure... ugh, my chest is suffocating...
A-are you okay!?
Yes, somehow...
A-and... if it's for your sake,\nthis is nothing...
Oh, I made tea too.\nWould you like some?
Y-yes. Please.
This tea helps you relax.\nIt puts you in a really easygoing mood.
The scent is a bit strong, but once you drink it,\nit goes down really smooth.
Here you go!
(M-her chest is so close...)
Also, if you'd like... some cookies?
Haruka taught me how to make them.
A-and... um...\nHaruka told me to do this too...
Um...\nwell, um...
A-ahhh...
H-ham! So tasty!!
I always do this with Haruka, but\nit's my first time with a boy... it's kind of embarrassing.
But if it makes you work hard at studying,\nI'll do it as many times as it takes...
Ick! T-that's...
Well then, let's get right to the reference book...
Huh? Studying again!?\nAnything but that...
...Hm? Hmm... huh?
Hehe, you looked like you were\nsleeping very soundly?
Oh, it was a dream...\nPhew... good.
(Ah, but the maid outfit was nice...)
Now let's continue studying.
Um, next is a math problem.\nJust memorizing formulas isn't enough.\nYou have to actually understand the logic...
And that's where this book comes in!!\nIt took a while, but\nit's finally finished!!
Um, is something wrong...?
Um, the cosplay...?
Huh, cosplay...?\nOh, you mean the academy festival exhibit?
Thanks to everyone, that's been\nsettled.\nNow, let's study!!
(Sigh... looks like there's nothing to do\nbut give up and study...)
